name: Xuất hồn kích
desc: spirit flames are born at the caster's chest, swell and leap out in many directions; six spirits of three sizes each take their own path (a high arc and a steep dive, a low skim that hooks back, a corkscrew, a zigzag that hits the ground first, a lazy one that fizzles out, one that circles the caster first) and strike the target one after another; the big dive bursts on the head, spreads a wave of cyan ground fire with lilac tips and covers the target in a ghost silhouette; purple wisps and motes rise as it all fades. The target stands 340 px ahead of the anchor on the ground (+62 px); the ghost is drawn on a generic dummy mask (no dummy body is drawn)
